How it works

## Simple, reliable telehealth designed around you

Three steps, all online. A licensed clinician makes every prescribing decision.

1

### Tell us about your health

Answer a short online assessment about your health history and goals. It takes a few minutes, 100% online.

2

### A licensed clinician reviews it

A state-licensed medical provider reviews your answers and decides whether treatment is clinically appropriate for you.

3

### Delivered to your door

If prescribed, most prescriptions are sent to a state-licensed pharmacy within two business days, then shipped discreetly to you.

## Provider-Guided NAD+

Licensed U.S. providers. State-licensed pharmacies. Discreet delivery.

![Smiling couple next to a vial of compounded NAD+](https://joinsprouthealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Nad-mobile-home.webp)

![Smiling couple next to a vial of compounded NAD+](https://joinsprouthealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/nad-desktop-home.webp)

### Compounded NAD+ Therapy

NAD+ is a compounded prescription-only medication which your clinician may prescribe based on your individual needs. It contains nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide.

As part of a holistic program, your provider may consider compounded NAD+, alongside other approaches. Consult with your provider about whether NAD+ is right for you.

_\*Image for illustration only. Medication is compounded and dispensed by a licensed third-party pharmacy. Sprout is not a pharmacy or drug manufacturer._

_Compounded NAD+ is not FDA-approved and has not been evaluated by the FDA for safety, effectiveness, or quality._
